description: This Kotlin source file contains internal utility functions for determining whether a host string represents a loopback or private LAN gateway. It includes functions to parse IP addresses, identify whether the code is running on an emulator, and check address types (IPv4, IPv6). The code appears to be part of networking or connectivity logic specific to Android devices.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if the given host string is a private local area network address, with additional considerations for loopback addresses and local network conventions.
